entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help. I bought a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor a few weeks ago, and it's just not working. I'm so disappointed. I saved up for this, and I really needed the money back if it wasn't going to work out.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your new VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a fault. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I've tried everything. I think the Bluetooth might be broken or something. Honestly, I think the unit I received is defective.
I see. It sounds frustrating when a new device doesn't work as expected. Let me pull up our policies for you. One moment... Okay, I'm just checking our knowledge base here.
Alright, I see here that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. When did you receive the band?
Umm, let me check my email... It was delivered on December 15th. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the first time I've had a problem. I was just really hoping for a refund.

Of course, I understand completely. December 15th... so that's 29 days ago. You are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
I see it! Thank you again. You've been wonderful.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
